blurb: Corcelettes Estate Winery is located on over 160 acres in the Similkameen Valley, producing small lot premium wines from estate and local vineyards. They offer wine tastings by appointment and a guest house stay at Sunshot Vineyard Guest House with panoramic valley views. The winery focuses on sustainable viticulture and has a portfolio including Bordeaux varietals, Syrah, Pinot Noir, and Chardonnay.
extraNote: Minimum purchase of 6 bottles required for online wine orders to be shipped · Wine shipments require signature of sober adult 19+ · Wine is perishable and not responsible for damage from extreme weather during shipment · $80 housekeeping fee for guest house stay · 4pm check-in at winery for guest house stays · 2026 season for guest house and wine tastings
